end.summary:
Mahi named the four directions and linked sunrise with East.
Mahi said a magnet points North because North is cold or snowy.
The coldness explanation was not corrected before the lesson ended.
Teach-back was not passed; no skills were recorded.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the four directions and how a magnet can help find direction. Mahi correctly connected sunrise with East, but mixed up magnetic direction with the idea that North is cold; this was not corrected before stopping. At home, use a bar magnet and compass to observe which end points North, then discuss that this is due to Earth’s magnetic field, not temperature.
